# Evolving Nexus

> A transformational learning and research initiative founded by Nish Dubashia
> and Marie Murtagh, exploring consciousness, meaning and the structure of
> reality through live online programs, research, writing and dialogue.

Evolving Nexus brings together insights from psychology, philosophy, science,
spirituality and human development to explore two fundamental questions: how is
reality structured, and how do we find meaning within it?

The work is grounded in the conviction that no single tradition, discipline or
worldview contains the whole picture. Understanding ourselves and our world
requires a deeper conversation, one capable of holding together inner and outer,
reason and spirituality, ancient wisdom and contemporary knowledge, individuality
and relationship, being and becoming.

Through courses, research, writing and dialogue, Evolving Nexus is developing an
integrative approach to consciousness, meaning and human transformation.

Something new is evolving: this site is currently a coming-soon page and the
full site is in development. As Evolving Nexus takes shape, the mailing list is
where the growing conversations around living consciously in a rapidly changing
world are shared.

## Two paths of exploration

Four programs are organized around two complementary streams.

**The Structure of Reality** explores the deeper patterns through which
consciousness, cosmos and reality may be understood.

- *The Diamond Paradigm: Fundamentals* introduces the Diamond Model, a map of
  reality, consciousness and human development. Six sessions.
- *The Diamond Paradigm: Advanced* takes the paradigm into developmental and
  nondual territory and applies it to personal and collective transformation.
  Eight sessions.

**The Meaning of Life** explores consciousness, human development, relationship,
purpose and transformation.

- *The Architecture of Human Consciousness* maps how people develop and why they
  see the world as they do. Foundational; assumes no prior study. Six sessions.
- *The Seven Principles* examines the structures every culture has used to make
  meaning. Eight sessions.

All programs are taught live and remotely by both founders, in cohorts that move
through the material together. Cohorts run across the United States and Europe.
Every program is taught using the OMEGA framework, the school's own teaching
methodology.

## The Diamond Model

The Diamond Model is Nish Dubashia's own framework for understanding the
structure of reality, developed over four decades of study across philosophy,
science and the contemplative traditions. It is the basis of the Structure of
Reality programs and is his own work rather than a synthesis of other people's.

## Founders

**Marie Murtagh**, Co-Founder. Researcher, educator and integrative thinker whose
work explores consciousness, human development, meaning and transformation. Came
from information technology and served many years as Chief Operating Officer of
an international training organization. Draws together psychological insight,
philosophical inquiry and contemplative understanding, with a particular interest
in how our ways of knowing shape our experience of ourselves, others and the
world.

**Nish Dubashia**, Co-Founder. British author, philosopher and educator.
Background in mathematics and more than four decades of engagement with the
world's philosophical and wisdom traditions. Author of *Gifted*, *Dancing with
Angels*, *The Unity of Everything: A Conversation with David Bohm* and *A Brief
History of God*. Creator of the Diamond Model. Has presented at the Global Forum
at MIT, UNESCO World Philosophy Day in Paris, the Integral European Conference
and the Science of Consciousness Conference.

## Recognition

Ken Wilber, founder of Integral Theory, on *The Book of Becoming: An Integral
Nondual Manifesto for a World in Transition*, co-authored by Nish Dubashia with
Hans Plasqui and Daniela Bomatter: "This is a superb book, highly recommended. I
can vouch that the authors thoroughly and deeply understand Integral Theory and
represent it accurately."

## Frequently asked questions

**Who is Evolving Nexus for?**
Coaches, consultants and facilitators. Leaders and managers. Therapists,
educators and researchers. People with a long contemplative practice. What they
share is work that depends on understanding how people think, develop and make
decisions. No background in philosophy or psychology is needed.

**What will I learn in an Evolving Nexus program?**
How human development actually works, and what it means for what a person can
see, hear and act on at any given point. The Meaning of Life stream covers
consciousness, development, relationship and purpose. The Structure of Reality
stream covers the deeper patterns through which consciousness and cosmos may be
understood. Both are taught through the same framework, so they build on one
another.

**What is the Diamond Model?**
The Diamond Model is Nish Dubashia’s own framework for understanding the
structure of reality, developed over four decades of study across philosophy,
science and the contemplative traditions. It is the spine of the Structure of
Reality programs at Evolving Nexus, and it is his own work rather than a
synthesis of other people’s.

**Do I need a background in philosophy or psychology?**
No. The Architecture of Human Consciousness is the starting point and assumes no
prior study. If you have already read widely, people in that position usually
say the reading was never the hard part. The hard part was that no single book
explains how the different accounts relate.

**How long are the Evolving Nexus programs?**
One live session a week, plus reading or practice in between. Courses run six or
eight sessions depending on which one. They are taught as seminars rather than
lectures, so the discussion carries much of the learning.

**How are Evolving Nexus sessions run?**
Live and remote, with both Marie Murtagh and Nish Dubashia present, in a cohort
that moves through the material together. Cohorts run across the United States
and Europe, and session times are set so people in both can attend live.

**What happens when I join the Evolving Nexus mailing list?**
You receive occasional reflections on consciousness, meaning and reality, and
word of new courses, research and events as they are announced. One email to
confirm, and nothing you did not ask for.

## Topics

Consciousness studies, integral theory, nondualism, philosophy of mind, human
development, developmental psychology, transformational learning, philosophy of
religion, the Diamond Model.
